findings.evidence: `rg -n "apply_ringHomKer|symm_apply_ringHomKer|ker_toIdeal"` shows the ring-hom variants at lines 86 and 106, while `TauCeti/Algebra/HopfAlgebra/Kernel.lean:106` provides `ker_toIdeal`; the proofs at lines 92 and 112 use only `rw [quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_apply]` / `rw [quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply]`.
findings.fix: Make the normalization explicit with the existing `ker_toIdeal` lemma, or add/use a dedicated quotient-kernel normalization lemma so these proofs do not depend silently on reducibility of `ker`.
findings.issue: `quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_apply_ringHomKer` and `quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_ringHomKer` compile only because `H ⧸ (ker f hf).toIdeal` is definitionally the same as `H ⧸ RingHom.ker ...`; this is undocumented defeq across the Hopf-ideal wrapper and quotient type.

summary: The main proofs are short, but the normalized kernel variants rely on quotient-type definitional equality instead of making the kernel normalization explicit.
